acceptance: Legacy unittest collection is an exact subset of canonical pytest collection with zero missing and zero unexpected cases.
FAST and PACKET select the tiered workflow as their fresh exact-head blocking assurance.
PACKET fails closed when executable implementation changes have no changed packet test.
FINAL_HEAD, scheduled, harness-change and risk-triggered runs require the complete canonical, legacy-parity and runner-parity sweep.
Unknown or ambiguous paths select FINAL_HEAD.
Local results never substitute for required remote assurance.
VIT routing, SIQ READY and merge readiness remain blocking.
The exact candidate head passes its triggered complete sweep before merge.
rollback_trigger: tiered selection omission or false FAST/PACKET classification
required complete sweep fails to trigger
rollback: Forward-revert workflow routing to v0.1 complete-per-packet assurance and retain all failure evidence.
